screening.reason: Exclusion 4 (no autism-vs-control analysis): this is primarily a statistical-methods paper (mixed-effects models for resampled network statistics) demonstrated on ABIDE UCLA and Michigan autism subjects only, relating ADOS symptom-severity covariates to connectivity density within the autism group. No autism-vs-typically-developing group-difference analysis or diagnostic classification is performed; the only mention of healthy subjects (n=90, Michigan) is used to construct a baseline network for a methods illustration/simulation, not as a compared control group.
